    Lake Reintal Trail

    Ideal trail for beginners. 

    Length: approx. 8 km / Type: Classic 8 km and 3 km skating / Difficulty: easy

    Current opening hours are displayed in the trail report at: alpbachtal.at/loipenbericht.

    Parking lot Reintalersee Ost/Camping sites or parking lot Museum of Tyrolean Farms

    The route passes the Museum of Tyrolean Farms towards Breitenbach and makes a loop back. Ideally suited for beginners! There are several access points to the regional bus along the route.

    • Alpbach

      Lueger Valley Trail - Inneralpbach

      Cross-country skiing in the Luegergraben, a veritable winter joy!

      Length: approx. 9 km / Type: classic and skating / Difficulty: medium

      Please find current opening details in the cross-country skiing trails report

      Parking: Inneralpbach, Alpbacher Bergbahnen car park 200m up the road after Aparthotel Hummerau

      The trail starts from the Alpbacher Bergbahnen car park (free of charge) 200m up the road from the Aparthotel Hummerau. The course leads up the valley along the Lueger stream, towards the „Buben“ chapel and to the „Hochberg“ car park and further alongside the stream up to the turning point. Follow the loop trail out the valley . At the end of the trail walk along the road (approx. 50m) out of the valley and then turn right over the footpath/bridge back to the car park.

      Skating trail: the trail runs parallel to the Luegergraben classic trail and ends level with the „Hochberg“ car park. Ski back to the starting point.


      Learn more
    • Breitenbach

      Schönauer Cross-country Trail - Breitenbach

      The trail carries the Tyrolean cross-country seal of approval - wonderful, quiet location, removed from traffic.

      Length: approx. 14 km / Type: classic and skating / Difficulty: easy (link to other trails - medium difficulty and difficult)

      Please find current opening details in the cross-country skiing trails report

      Parking in Schönau; turn right after KFZ Auer; continue to a cross section; the parking lot is to the left (Schneider saw mill)

      The looped trail leads via Mariastein and Angerberg. A skating trail runs parallel to the classic trail. Experienced cross-country skiers can opt for a more demanding route. Inclinations and descents make for a varied and interesting trail to Angerberg. Depending on where one enters the trail one can cover 25 km choosing between, medium difficulty and difficult.

      Several Regiobus stops can be found along the way.
